verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents developer API keys, but the evidence never says they can be scoped, permission-limited or bound to an agent. The docs instead warn that "anyone with the API key can use the AnythingLLM API", which points to all-access keys. The fine-grained admin controls and RBAC cover users, not API credentials, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
